summary: Vaxcyte filed an 8-K disclosing consummation of a $575 million underwritten offering of 1.50% Convertible Senior Notes due October 15, 2032, issued October 9, 2026 under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. The notes are senior unsecured obligations paying semi-annually beginning April 15, 2027, with an initial conversion price of approximately $89.60 per share (11.1607 shares per $1,000). Provisional redemption is permitted on or after October 22, 2029 if the stock exceeds 130% of conversion price. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch conversion-driven dilution and hedging flows.
